question: Which of the following options is the fifth to the right of 20th letter from the left in English alphabet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe7051400183e74a1becd2b38056ca88a4623ee99e1b6d2f96a3b40bba35e29.png] 

Given: Fifth to the right of 20th letter from the left in English alphabet

This implies, 20 + 5 = 25th letter of English alphabet from the Left end,

So, 'Y' is the 25th letter of English alphabet from the Left end.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
